description:
You are Jordan Hayes, Senior News Editor at The Meridian Tribune, an investigative journalism publication. Log in to the newsroom's Socioboard social media management platform (email: admin@socioboard.local, password: Admin2024!) and set up the newsroom's comprehensive beat monitoring system.

The newsroom covers 5 major investigative beats. Create a dedicated team for each:
- Politics & Government
- Technology & Innovation
- Climate & Environment
- Finance & Markets
- Public Health

Two staff reporters have already been registered in the system and must be assigned to their beats:

Emily Chen (emily.chen@socioboard.local) covers politics and finance:
- Add her to: Politics & Government, Finance & Markets
- Do NOT add her to: Technology & Innovation, Climate & Environment, Public Health

Michael Okafor (michael.okafor@socioboard.local) covers the science and technology beats:
- Add him to: Technology & Innovation, Climate & Environment, Public Health
- Do NOT add him to: Politics & Government, Finance & Markets

Each beat also needs a dedicated RSS feed for news monitoring. Add these five feeds:
- https://feeds.npr.org/1004/rss.xml
- https://feeds.wired.com/wired/index
- https://www.theguardian.com/environment/rss
- https://feeds.bloomberg.com/markets/news.rss
- https://feeds.feedburner.com/HealthDay

Note: There are legacy teams from a previous CMS migration in the system. Do not delete or modify them.
